title: NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE
text: The UE shall behave as specified in subclause5.3.5

The UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE substate, if configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPPTS31.102[22], shall perform the eCall inactivity procedure at expiry of timer T3444 or timer T3445 (see subclause5.5.3)
